CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c) || ISBLANK(End_Date__c), 0, IF(ISPICKVAL(Day_Selection__c, "1st Half") || ISPICKVAL(Day_Selection__c, "2nd Half"), 0.5, (End_Date__c - Start_Date__c + 1) - ( FLOOR((End_Date__c - Start_Date__c + 1) / 7) * 2 + IF( MOD(End_Date__c - Start_Date__c + 1, 7) >= (8 - WEEKDAY(Start_Date__c)), MIN(2, MOD(End_Date__c - Start_Date__c + 1, 7) - (7 - WEEKDAY(Start_Date__c)) + 1), IF(WEEKDAY(Start_Date__c) = 1 || WEEKDAY(Start_Date__c) = 7, 1, 0) + IF( Start_Date__c != End_Date__c && (WEEKDAY(End_Date__c) = 1 || WEEKDAY(End_Date__c) = 7), 1, 0) ) ) ))
CustomField.label: No of day
